title: Distribution/engagement acceptance
scope_items: Acceptance Target 1 (Five acceptance paths): Implemented and verified all five acceptance paths across Go, Web, and Mobile: Path 1 Happy Path (native API publish loops to unified inbox with valid 24h reply compose), Path 2 Degraded Path (manual fallback package generation, operator proof upload with graph retention, and degraded inbox notes), Path 3 Missing Data Path (validation rejects missing proof evidence or expired window without state corruption), Path 4 Broken Path (credential revocation pauses queued jobs targeting that account, ghost message WHAT-WHY-NEXT blocks replies), and Path 5 Audit Path (immutable publish logs with evidence reference, operator ID, and domain outbox event stream).

Acceptance Target 2 (Replay with one external result): Execute publish job idempotency ensures repeated calls with identical idempotency key or on already-published items return the existing external post ID, URL, log, and channel post without calling the external platform adapter a second time or creating duplicate log records. Webhook delivery deduplication (IngestInboundMessageWithExternalID) prevents duplicate thread message increments on repeated webhook deliveries.

Acceptance Target 3 (Commerce/seeding actions retain P6 task links): Upstream engagement thread conversions to downstream business objects (ConvertToSampleRequest, ConvertToBrandDeal, ConvertToOffer) retain explicit P6 task links (P6-09 for seeding/brand deals, P6-01 for monetization/offers) with task_ref, phase='P6', is_p6_deferred=true, and status='pending_p6_delivery' in related_object_refs and FollowUpTask without claiming local completion of P6 delivery.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestPublishInboxLoop_Path1_HappyPath, Path2_DegradedPath, Path3_MissingDataPath, Path4_BrokenPath, and Path5_AuditPath pass in Go with -race, in Vitest for Web, and in Flutter for Mobile.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestPublishInboxLoop_Target2_ReplayWithOneExternalResult verifies single connector dispatch on execution replays and idempotent webhook deduplication; verified in Go, Vitest, and Flutter.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestPublishInboxLoop_Target3_CommerceSeedingRetainP6TaskLinks verifies P6 task links (P6-01, P6-09), deferred delivery flags, and follow-up task preservation across Go, Web, and Mobile.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, 4-target codegen, zero drift check, zero buf breaking against origin/main, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Full CI Quality Gates Verified: check_d0.sh, check_proto.sh, check_go.sh (all packages with race detector), check_node.sh (svelte-check, build, vitest 30 test files, real SSR smoke), and check_flutter.sh (analyze 0 issues, 201 tests passing) all pass cleanly.
external_gates: TikTok Content Posting and Webhook APIs require approved Developer App credentials; verified via mock platform adapter and manual export flow.
Instagram Content Publishing and Webhook subscriptions require Meta App Review; verified via mock adapter and manual proof flow.
PostgreSQL composite keys, RLS policies, and immutable logs verified in local test suite; multi-tenant live database verification executes in CI.
